source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Increasing the degree of inflammation surrounding the client's tumor, an effect opposite to what this medication actually produces","B":"Directly shrinking the size of the underlying tumor itself, rather than addressing the surrounding inflammatory edema","C":"Carrying fairly little established role in this particular clinical context despite being routinely used for this purpose","D":"Reducing inflammation and capillary permeability associated with the tumor, particularly effective for vasogenic edema related to tumors"}}
source_row.rationale: Dexamethasone helps reduce cerebral edema related to a brain tumor by reducing inflammation and capillary permeability, particularly effective for vasogenic edema (the type of edema often associated with tumors), though it does not directly treat the tumor itself.
source_row.source_name: FDA Prescribing Information — Dexamethasone, Cerebral Edema Use
